_comment: Copy to claudewatch.json (beside the exe, or in %USERPROFILE%\.claude\), or point %CLAUDEWATCH_CONFIG% at it. Every key is optional; omitted keys keep their default (shown below). Colors accept names (e.g. brightCyan, orange) or raw ANSI SGR params (e.g. 38;5;208). 'default'/'none'/'' mean no color. Set NO_COLOR=1 in the environment to disable all color.
